title: Essential final ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must be the ratio T1:T2 = 5:3.

title: Essential force equilibrium
description: Essential Criteria: The student must apply force equilibrium (sum of vertical forces = 0) for both configurations.

title: Important current calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total current through the rod using Ohm's law for each configuration.

title: Important Ampere force
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the magnetic (Ampere) force on the rod using F = BIL, identifying the correct length L for each configuration.

title: Important geometry/trigonometry
description: Important Criteria: For configuration 1, the student must use the given geometry to find the sine of the wire angle (sin 37° = 0.6).

title: Pitfall incorrect length
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalise using the wrong effective length (e.g., 3L instead of L) for the Ampere force in configuration 2.

title: Pitfall sign or direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalise incorrect handling of force directions (e.g., Ampere force added vs. subtracted) in the equilibrium equations.

title: Optional unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates dimensional consistency in intermediate force expressions.
